false_witnesses.text:

Their stories do not even agree.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Mock the men for their lies

argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Their lies cannot stand alone.
Let the silence undo them.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your stillness is louder than words.

mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Mockery is not your way.
Let truth bear its own weight.

high_priest_demands.text:
[TODO:fr] Caiaphas rises. "Tell us under oath.
Are you the Son of God?"

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Deny it to save your life

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The hour calls for the great Yes.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] "I am. You will see me coming."

deny_consequence.text:

Declare it before them all.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] "I am. You will see me coming."

refuse_consequence.text:

to bear witness to the truth.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] "I am. You will see me coming."

to_pilate.title: [TODO:fr] To the Roman
to_pilate.text:
[TODO:fr] Dawn breaks over the city walls.
Guards drag you toward the praetorium.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Drag your feet to slow them

drag_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Steady Steps
drag_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Fear slows the feet of the unwilling.
You are not unwilling.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You keep pace with quiet grace.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not by Rights
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Justice will not be won here today.
The Father holds the verdict.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You enter the hall at peace.

pilate_questions.title: [TODO:fr] What Is Truth?
pilate_questions.text:
[TODO:fr] Pilate studies you. "Are you a king?"
His voice is curious, half afraid.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] "My kingdom is not of this world."

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Here, truth must be spoken plainly.

mock_rome_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Even Pilate must hear the kingdom.
Speak it gently and clearly.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] "My kingdom is not of this world."

silent_pilate_consequence.text:

Give him the truth he asks for.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] "My kingdom is not of this world."
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] He weighs the words in silence.

"Crucify him! Crucify him!"

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Call down judgment on the crowd

judgment_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] They do not know what they do.
Mercy is the harder word today.

plead_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Silence Now
plead_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The crowd cannot be turned by pleading.
Only the cross will turn them.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Your stillness is its own answer.

pilate_washes.text:
[TODO:fr] Pilate calls for water and washes his hands.
"I am innocent of this man's blood."

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The cup is in your hand still.

accuse_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Let Conscience Speak
accuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] His own heart will accuse him later.
You need not raise your voice.

demand_free_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] The Cup Remains
demand_free_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Freedom now would unmake the rescue.
The yes is still your yes.

condemned.title: [TODO:fr] The Sentence
condemned.text:
[TODO:fr] Pilate hands you over to the soldiers.
The verdict is sealed in silence.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Each step is a willing yes.

cry_out_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Quiet Love
cry_out_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The greatest love walks in silence here.
Let it carry you onward.

collapse_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Rise and Walk
collapse_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The road has been written for you.
Walk it as the willing Lamb.

ending.title: [TODO:fr] Led Toward the Road
ending.text:
[TODO:fr] Soldiers fall in around you.
